C0253.title: SPP Releases Typical Case Involving Image Theft Infringement
C0253.summary: On April 22, 2026, the Supreme People Procuratorate released typical intellectual property protection cases, including the Fu and three others copyright ownership and infringement false litigation supervision case. Offenders created vector graphics by tracing and matting, used fabricated publication statements and other false materials to obtain copyright registration certificates, then knowingly purchased the works and fabricated infringement facts to file false lawsuits. Prosecutors corrected the conduct through supervision.
